name: Centpropazine
summary: Centpropazine (CPZ, CTZ) is an experimental antidepressant of the phenylpiperazine family which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder in India but was never marketed. It is described as having imipramine-like clinical effects, reversing reserpine-induced effects in animals, and potentiating amphetamine-induced effects in animals. The mechanism of action of centpropazine is unknown.
